art_note: The lifestyle shots feature visibly composited backgrounds and mannequins, reducing the luxury perception, though studio product shots are clean.
desc_en: This piece embodies the fusion of relaxed tailoring and bold graphic design. Tailored with a fluid silhouette, it features a vibrant interplay of paisley and floral motifs across an intense chromatic palette. Short sleeves and a V-neckline define a sophisticated summer aesthetic. Each panel is precisely cut and assembled to ensure visual continuity. A versatile garment conceived for leisurely days or informal gatherings under the sun. Made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Esta pieza encarna la fusión entre la sastrería relajada y el diseño gráfico audaz. Confeccionada con una silueta fluida, presenta un vibrante juego de patrones paisley y florales en una paleta cromática intensa. Las mangas cortas y el cuello en V definen una estética estival sofisticada. Cada panel está cortado y ensamblado de manera precisa para asegurar la continuidad del motivo visual. Una prenda versátil concebida para eldays of leisure o encuentros informales bajo el sol. Made to order and available with worldwide shipping.
